Practical answers

Frequently asked questions from salons and wellness businesses.

Which POS suits my salon or beauty business?

Depending on treatments, products, staff and appointments, KassaKompas compares starter POS and full systems. A demo using your services makes differences clear.

Can I manage appointments and online bookings?

Suitable booking software supports appointments. We check the application, possible integration and data exchanged with POS.

Can I check out treatments and products together?

This is important for salons and wellness. We assess recording services, treatment options and products on one bill.

Can I use digital client records?

We define useful data, such as preferences and purchases, supported features, access rights and careful record maintenance.

Can I keep my payment terminal or scanner?

We check devices, payment provider and software. Existing hardware is not assumed compatible; we advise beforehand what can stay.

Can I manage multiple staff and working hours?

We review permissions, staff reports and any scheduling/time tracking. Not every feature is standard; modules are chosen for your team.

What does a salon or wellness POS cost?

Costs depend on devices, modules, integrations and guidance. Ask for separate one-off and recurring costs.
